title: Silicon Clarity — Cupertino Product Stage
description: An Apple-keynote-grade product feature slide built on strict vertical symmetry: one commanding headline, a single subhead line, and a silhouetted device floating over a cool radial gradient floor — nothing else competes for attention.
philosophy: This template exists to prove that restraint is the loudest design choice in a room full of noise. It borrows the visual grammar of apple.com — SF Display weight, iceberg-white negative space, and a gradient that suggests depth without admitting to it. It refuses decorative elements, bullet points, and any layout asymmetry on principle. It is built for a speaker who trusts a single image and twelve words to carry a room.
goodFor: Hardware or physical product launch announcements
Single-feature highlight slides within a longer keynote deck
Tech startup investor decks showcasing a flagship product
Conference openers where a product image must land before any words do
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly business reviews requiring data density
Multi-point agenda or roadmap slides with three or more items
Academic or research presentations needing citations and body text
Brand decks for warm, artisanal, or handcrafted product categories
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide evokes a darkened keynote stage the moment before the product reveal — hushed, expectant, absolutely still. Composition is perfectly centered and iceberg-spare: the device holds the upper field while a headline and subhead pair rest directly beneath it, the surrounding void amplifying both. A cool radial gradient suggests a diffuse studio glow behind the product — depth present but never announced. No texture, ornamentation, or drop shadows should disturb the product's solitude.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed single-column layout with strict vertical and horizontal centering throughout; all content is anchored within cols 3–10 of a 12-column grid, preserving deep breathing margins on each flank. The silhouetted product image occupies the upper-center zone — roughly the top three-fifths of the canvas — with the headline set directly beneath it and the subhead tucked close below, hierarchy achieved through scale contrast alone with no rule lines or color breaks. A centered radial gradient blooms from the lower-center of the canvas outward, providing the only spatial depth cue on the slide. No header band, no decorative footer; if a page identifier appears it sits alone at bottom-center in minimal form.

examples.promptCore: The slide feels like a darkened stage with a single spotlight — the product image hovers in cool, ambient luminance as if gravity opted out. Mood is clinical reverence: the kind of concentrated silence that precedes a product reveal, where confidence needs no decoration to fill the room. Compositional rhythm is perfectly symmetric and unhurried, negative space carrying more weight than any element placed inside it. Avoid warmth, organic texture, asymmetric tension, or any secondary visual that competes with the singular product moment at center.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid, all content locked to cols 4–9 with a 10% outer margin on every edge — strict vertical center axis, no deviation. Vertical stack from top to bottom: product or device image occupies the upper-center two-thirds of the canvas as the undisputed focal anchor, followed by a single feature headline at commanding scale, then one subhead line of supporting copy. Hierarchy is achieved through scale contrast alone — no rule lines, no dividers, no icon badges, no background panels. Slide number sits bottom-center at the smallest legible scale; nothing else shares the floor.
